children: Overview
China biopharma developer's interim net loss widened 263% yr/yr to RMB319.7 mln
Total income for the period fell 49% yr/yr
R&D expenses surged 133% yr/yr due to expanded metabolic disease pipeline investment
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods in the press release
Result Drivers
R&D EXPENSES - Co said net loss widened mainly due to a 133% yr/yr surge in R&D costs from expanded metabolic disease pipeline investment
INCOME DECLINE - Co reported total income fell 49% yr/yr, contributing to wider losses
